Self.Wiki: A group of enemies fought together (a battle group), with the item lots awarded for defeating them.

TargetEntityGroupID.Wiki: The entity group of the enemies in this fight.

OverrideItemLotEventFlagID0.Wiki: If this event flag is on, Override Item Lot 1 is given instead of the normal item lot. Checked before the second pair.

OverrideItemLotParamID0.Wiki: The item lot given while Override Item Lot Event Flag 1 is on.

OverrideItemLotEventFlagID1.Wiki: If this event flag is on (and the first is off), Override Item Lot 2 is given instead of the normal item lot.

OverrideItemLotParamID1.Wiki: The item lot given while Override Item Lot Event Flag 2 is on.
